import openpyxl
import os

input_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/16511/1_16511_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/16511_1_9d908d9c/1_16511_output.xlsx"

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb.active

# Fill F2:F10 with a formula that counts how many times the current album
# name has appeared from the first data row through the current row.
# This produces track numbers that restart/increment per album.
for row in range(2, 11):
    ws[f"F{row}"] = f'=COUNTIF($D$2:D{row},D{row})'

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
